Libraries
```{r setup}


library(reticulate)
reticulate::use_condaenv("mofa2_env", required = TRUE)
reticulate::py_config()
reticulate::py_module_available("mofapy2")

library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(Biobase)
library(svdxBenchmark)
library(svdx)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)
```

```{r load-raw}
#Read counts, generate and save sparse matrix

  countsFile <- "./GSE193531_umi-count-matrix.csv" 
  mati <- fread( file=countsFile, header=T)
  spmati <- mltools::sparsify(mati[,-1])
  rownames(spmati) <- mati$V1
  rm( mati, countsFile )
  
  #Read metadata
  metaFile <- "./GSE193531_cell-level-metadata.csv" 
  meta <- fread( file=metaFile, header=T )
  saveRDS( list(spmat=spmati,
                meta=meta
                ), 
           file="./SPARSE_WITH_META_GSE193531_umi-count-matrix.RDS") 
  

dat <- readRDS( file= "./SPARSE_WITH_META_GSE193531_umi-count-matrix.RDS" )

#Pseudo bulk
donor <- unique(dat$meta$sample_ID)
us<- unique( dat$meta$sample_ID )
ns <- sapply( us, function(s) sum( dat$meta$sample_ID == s ) )
pseudo <- do.call(cbind, lapply( us, function(s){
  si <- which( dat$meta$sample_ID == s )
  Matrix::rowSums( dat$spmat[,si] )
} ) )
group <- sapply(strsplit( donor, "-" ), function(x) x[[1]][1])
table(group)
pd <- data.frame( donor=donor, group=group ); rownames(pd) = colnames(pseudo)
pd$group <- factor(pd$group, levels=c("NBM", "MGUS", "SMM", "MM"))
pseudo <- ExpressionSet( assayData = pseudo, phenoData=AnnotatedDataFrame(pd)  )
pseudo <- pseudo[which( rowSums( exprs(pseudo) )>0  ), ]
tj <- colSums( exprs(pseudo) ); tj <- tj/exp(mean(log(tj))); stopifnot( all(is.finite(tj)) )

#tech data
meta1 <- read.csv(file="./MM_annotations_merged.csv" ) 
meta1 <- meta1[ match( pseudo$donor, meta1$Boiarsky2022_IDs ), ]

# 138P samples as they correspond to plasma cells fraction used in this study
meta2 <- read.csv(file="./sample_info_10X_May4.txt", sep="\t" )
meta2_batches <- do.call(rbind, lapply( meta1$dfci_id, function(id){
  s <- meta2[grep( id, meta2$sample ),]
  s[ which( grepl( "138P$", s$sample ) ),,drop=F ]
} ) ) 
meta2_batches_final <- meta2_batches[ match( meta1$dfci_id, unlist(strsplit(meta2_batches$sample, "CD138P") ) ), ]

newMeta <-  data.frame( meta1, meta2_batches_final )
pd <- pd %>% 
  bind_cols( newMeta %>% 
               dplyr::select( dfci_id, Zavidij2020_IDs, Boiarsky2022_IDs, sample, batch ) 
             )
pd$batch <- factor( pd$batch )
table( pd$batch, pd$group )
rownames( pd ) <- colnames(pseudo)

fd <- data.frame( id = rownames(pseudo), symbol = rownames(pseudo) )
rownames(fd) <- rownames(pseudo)

es <- ExpressionSet( assayData = exprs(pseudo),
                              phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame(pd),
                              featureData =AnnotatedDataFrame(fd)
                              )



```



# Run 
```{r}
xformula = ~group
zformula = ~batch

  fdata <- fData(es)
  Y_raw <- exprs(es)
  xdata <- pData(es) #%>% mutate( TissueGroup = paste(Tissue, Group) ) 
  zdata <- xdata
  
  row_offsets <- rep(0, nrow(es))
  col_offsets <- rep(0, ncol(es))
  t_j <- colSums( exprs(es) ); t_j <- t_j/exp(mean(log(t_j)))
  
  fdata <- as_svdx_fdata(
    fdata,
    feature_col = "id", #these are the rownames in the circ data
    label_col = "symbol", #these are what we will use for labeling features in plots
    enrichment_col = "symbol" #these are what we will use for enrichment when we do inferecne
    )

  prepared <- svdx:::prepare_svdx_data(
    Y = Y_raw,
    xdata = xdata,
    zdata = zdata,
    xformula = xformula,
    zformula = zformula,
    fdata = fdata,
    family = NULL, 
    log1p_transform = TRUE,              #already transformed      
    t_j = t_j,
    normalize = TRUE,                    #data has already been normalization
    top_ftrs = 5000,
    center_rows = TRUE,    
    scale_rows = TRUE,
    allow_sparse_densification = TRUE,
    col_offset = col_offsets,
    row_offset = row_offsets,
    dataset_name = "mm_plasma"
  )

  
  METHODS <- c(
  "svdx",
  "pca",
  #"mefisto_duplicate_view", #no mefisto as only categorical covarates
  "nmf",
  "mixomics_pls",
  "spca",
  "sparse_nmf"
  )
SPCA_KEEPX_GRID <- round(c(0.01, 0.25, 0.5) * nrow(prepared$Y))
SPARSE_NMF_LAMBDA_GRID <- 10^c(-3, -2, -1)

#benchmark
rw_single <- run_real_world_single_benchmark(
  
  Y = prepared$Y,
  
  K = 15,
  
  train_fraction = 1,
  
  data = prepared$xdata,
  xformula = prepared$xformula,
  zdata = prepared$zdata,
  zformula = prepared$zformula,
  fdata = fdata, 

  methods = METHODS,
  inference_methods = c("svdx"), ftol_abs = 1e-5, fitter_maxIter = 400, 
  
  run_factorization = TRUE,
  run_inference = FALSE,
  
  inference_scope = "all",
  feature_sets = NULL,
  enrichment_backend = "internal",
  msigdb_db_species = "Hs", 
  msigdb_species = "Homo sapiens", 
  msigdb_collection = "C5", 
  msigdb_subcollection = "BP"
)

#output

rw <- runSingleBenchmarkReports(rw_single = rw_single, 
                                    outdir = "./mm_plasma",
                                overwrite=T, 
                                 color="group", group="group", line_group = "group",
                                xaxis="group", 
                                 loading_enrichment = T, 
                                    enrichment_top_n = 20, 
                                svdx_report_args = list( z_adjustment = "fitted", 
                                                         heatmap_order_by = c("group","batch"), 
                                                         feature_profile_show_se = T , 
                                                         feature_profile_color = "group", 
                                                         feature_profiles_top_n = 5L,
                                                         x ="group"
                                                         )
                                 )
  
  
  



```

    width = 30,
    height = 20
)

# supplementary

  rw_single,
  outdir="./SN5_MMPlasma_supplementary",
  dataset_title = "multiple myeloma study. Given the smaller sample size, only a factorization analysis was done. The figures include components, their decompositions, and heatmaps of top 50 features with highest absolute loadings",

  start_figure = 168L,#45 figs in circadian, 89 end in bilateral, 167 end in malaria, 210 end in OT1
  methods = NULL,
  components = NULL,
  u_plot_specs = NULL,
  color="group", 
  group="group", 
  line_group = "group",
  xaxis = "group",
  facet = NULL,
  features_top_n = 50L,
  enrichment_top_n = 25L,
  enrichment_fdr = 0.1,
  volcano_labels_top_n = 10L,
  volcano_label_features = NULL,
  svdx_report_args = list(
    heatmap_order_by = c("group", "batch"), 
    heatmap_annotate = c("group", "batch")
  ),
  text_size = 25,
  compile = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE, 
  loading_heatmaps = T, 
  loading_enrichment = T
)
